_comment: Source of truth for the 'Colaboradores' logo band at the bottom of every page.
Edit this file (or use tools/partner_logos.py --add) and re-render; never hand-edit
the band markup in the HTML, because all four pages must stay identical.
slots = total tiles rendered. Any slot beyond the logos listed renders as a marked
empty placeholder. Riki reviewed the six-slot version on 2026-08-03 and read the five
empties as unfinished ('Hay muchos y se ven como libre ... esta raro eso?'), so slots
now tracks the real logo count. Raise it again only to reserve space deliberately.
Keep slots <= 6: the .stagger entrance in css/styles.css defines delays for six children.
